instruction: Tidy up my desk: pens stand upright in the magenta pen holder, the mug goes on the blue coaster, the notebook goes on the pile of books, and crumpled paper balls go into the red wastebasket. Some things are already where they belong; leave them there.

attempts.code:
# Grasp the edge-pinch candidate for yellow_notebook and place it on book_pile
candidates = grasp_candidates("yellow_notebook")
# Filter for valid edge pinch candidates with free edge below
pinch_cands = [c for c in candidates if c.get("edge_free_below", False)]
cand = pinch_cands[0] if pinch_cands else candidates[0]

approach = cand["approach"]
finger_axis = cand.get("finger_axis", [0, 0, 1])
grip_x, grip_y = cand["x"], cand["y"]
grip_z = observe()["table_z"] + cand["height"]

# Open gripper and approach horizontally from 5 cm back
open_gripper()
back_dist = 0.05
pre_x = grip_x - approach[0] * back_dist
pre_y = grip_y - approach[1] * back_dist
pre_z = grip_z - approach[2] * back_dist

move_gripper(pre_x, pre_y, pre_z, approach=approach, finger_axis=finger_axis)
move_by(
    approach[0] * back_dist, approach[1] * back_dist, approach[2] * back_dist
)
close_gripper()

# Lift straight up to safe carrying height
move_by(dz=0.20)

# Move above book_pile
obs = observe()
pile = obs["zones"]["book_pile"]
pile_center = pile["center"]
pile_top_z = obs["table_z"] + pile["top_height"]

# Move horizontally above pile centre keeping gripper orientation
move_gripper(
    pile_center[0],
    pile_center[1],
    pile_top_z + 0.10,
    approach=approach,
    finger_axis=finger_axis,
)

# Lower until contact onto the book pile
lower_until_contact()
open_gripper()
retreat(0.12)
go_home()
check("yellow_notebook", "book_pile")

candidates = grasp_candidates("yellow_notebook")
obs = observe()
table_z = obs["table_z"]

# Check candidates with solve_ik to ensure reachability
chosen = None
for c in candidates:
    if c.get("edge_free_below", False):
        app = c["approach"]
        # Try both finger_axis directions: [0, 0, 1] and [0, 0, -1]
        for f_axis in [[0, 0, 1], [0, 0, -1]]:
            # Test pre-grasp pose (back 0.04m along approach)
            gx, gy, gz = c["x"], c["y"], table_z + c["height"]
            px, py, pz = (
                gx - app[0] * 0.04,
                gy - app[1] * 0.04,
                gz - app[2] * 0.04,
            )
            ik = solve_ik(px, py, pz, approach=app, finger_axis=f_axis)
            if ik["reachable"]:
                chosen = (c, app, f_axis, px, py, pz, gx, gy, gz)
                break
        if chosen:
            break

if chosen:
    cand, app, f_axis, px, py, pz, gx, gy, gz = chosen
    open_gripper()
    move_gripper(px, py, pz, approach=app, finger_axis=f_axis)
    move_gripper(gx, gy, gz, approach=app, finger_axis=f_axis)
    close_gripper()
    move_by(dz=0.20)
    pile = obs["zones"]["book_pile"]
    pz_top = table_z + pile["top_height"]
    move_gripper(
        pile["center"][0],
        pile["center"][1],
        pz_top + 0.12,
        approach=app,
        finger_axis=f_axis,
    )
    lower_until_contact()
    open_gripper()
    retreat(0.12)
else:
    # Fallback to standard grasp candidate if any fits
    cands = [c for c in candidates if c.get("fits_open_fingers", False)]
    if cands:
        grasp(cands[0])
        pile = obs["zones"]["book_pile"]
        carry_to(pile["center"][0], pile["center"][1], height=0.25)
        lower_until_contact()
        open_gripper()
        retreat(0.12)

go_home()
